address: Pikes Hill, Romsey Road, Lyndhurst, New Forest,SO43 7AS
bio: Formerly the Georgian Dower House of the Northerwood Estate, Forest Lodge Hotel lies just outside the popular village of Lyndhurst, the capital of the New Forest.  Offering a contemporary twist on afternoon tea with a seasonal menu that features the best flavours of the forest, the 1820 restaurant's chic interior and the team's relaxed, friendly approach to service creates a warm and invite space for a sumptuous afternoon experience.  Offering a contemporary twist on 'Alice in Wonderland' the Afternoon Tea with delicious, sweet and savouries is the perfect way to enjoy one of the most quintessential of English traditions in one of the most beautiful settings.  The restaurant chic interior is complete with walnut tables, potted plants, interesting fabrics and contemporary artwork, creates a warm and inviting space for a wonderful afternoon tea dining experience.  Not forgetting the little ones there is a specially designed Afternoon Tea with all the favourites and a little fun activity to keep them entertained.
